title: Japan Is Giving the United States a Chance in Asia
author: David Sacks
text:

Request reprint permissions here.Japan, a country constitutionally bound to pacifism since World War II, is investing in its defense and contributing to regional security in ways that were previously unthinkable. Tokyo has nearly doubled its defense budget, purchased long-range missiles capable of striking military targets in China and North Korea, signed agreements that allow it to deploy its military overseas, stepped into combat roles in multilateral military exercises, and even lifted its prohibition on exporting weapons.Japan’s current strategy benefits the United States.
